name: dsh-tool-todo-plus
description: todo_write tool with priority tags, markdown checklist rendering and a floating task panel — drop-in enhanced fork of @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=lib/index.js --legal-comments=none && node scripts/disable-eval.mjs && esbuild src/client.tsx --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=lib/client.js --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --external:react-dom --legal-comments=none --banner:js="window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: \"dsh-tool-todo-plus\", factory: (require) => { var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports;" --footer:js="return module.exports; } });"
